step_description: Converted raw Nanopore sequencing signal to FASTQ reads using Guppy base-calling software
Filtered sequencing reads for quality using Filtlong
Assembled filtered reads into a circular genome contig using Flye
Polished the assembled genome using Medaka
Annotated the genome with gene predictions and functional annotations using BV-BRC's bacteriophage pipeline
Performed additional functional predictions using InterProScan and BLASTx
Attempted phage termini analysis using PhageTerm
Mapped reads to the assembly to assess coverage distribution
Conducted BLASTn search to compare the genome against public databases
